Interface StreamedDocumentListener

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface StreamedDocumentListener
Notified about every document that Base64SplittingFilter streamed out of a request body, so that the application can meter the split without the split having to know about any particular metrics library.
